item.title: Verizon restores wireless service after massive outage
item.description: Verizon's widespread wireless service outage on Wednesday affected thousands of customers and lasted nearly ten hours, caused by a software issue.

item.title: Astound launches East Coast fiber route
item.description: Astound Business Solutions has built a new fiber network route, spanning more than 300 miles and introducing 33.6 Tbit/s of additional capacity across the East Coast, from New York City to Ashburn, Virginia. #pressrelease

item.title: Optimum Mobile dials up new international and roaming plans
item.description: Optimum Communications has revamped its international and roaming plans for Optimum Mobile, including new 'Travel Pass' options. #pressrelease

item.title: California approves Verizon-Frontier deal… with conditions
item.description: California officials unanimously approved Verizon's acquisition of Frontier with a series of conditions and requirements tied to network buildouts and investments in DEI-related programs and initiatives.

item.title: AI drives semiconductor revenues past $1T for the first time in 2026 – Omdia
item.description: Growth is being driven by the rapid surge in memory and logic IC revenues, generated by massive demand from AI market. #pressrelease

item.title: New research calls for stronger consumer protections during 2G and 3G network shutdowns – Omdia
item.description: Europe is leading global 2G/3G network decommissioning, with a strong focus on retiring 3G services. #pressrelease

item.title: Ericsson and Nokia cuts reflect the grisly state of 5G
item.description: Combined headcount at Ericsson and Nokia has plummeted by more than 36,000 jobs since 2017, and there are more layoffs to come.

item.title: Eurobites: Kyivstar's D2D Starlink service takes off in Ukraine
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Eutelsat and MaiaSpace agree satellite launch deal; mobile and broadband price hikes in the UK; Arcep gets comical about AI.

item.title: The Buildout: Ziply marches on in Oregon
item.description: This week in broadband builds: Ziply Fiber locations live in Cottage Grove, Oregon; more North Carolinians get Spectrum; Comcast expands in Mississippi; Swyft Fiber completes construction in Louisiana's Allen Parish – and more.

item.title: Mediacom announces the passing of founder, chairman and CEO Rocco Commisso
item.description: Rocco Commisso, the founder, chairman and CEO of Mediacom Communications, has passed away. He founded Mediacom in 1995, took it public in 2000, and then took it private in 2011. #pressrelease
